summary: Hybrid desk kit staging for LON-2: peripheral pallet customs hold + contractor badge VLAN mismatch
description: Issue summary: A pallet of 12 hybrid-desk kits (monitors, docks, power bricks, monitor arms) destined for the new London-2 office was reported as ‘held at customs’ by the carrier. Separately, two contractor badges provisioned for the same onboarding batch are failing to authenticate to the Lon-2 desk VLAN and cannot access network shares.
impact: New hires and contractors scheduled to sit at LON-2 this week cannot receive full workstation kits and two contractors cannot join corporate network. Potential onboarding delays for 8 engineers and degraded roll-out of desks for a new team fusion week.
environment_notes: Shipments tracked to LON-2 (EU customs gateway). Local building network managed by Facilities + third-party managed NAC. No production services impacted; internal onboarding and desk readiness delayed.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Attempt badge swipe at desk portal → badge accepted by door but fails network authentication. 2) Attempt to join corp-wifi with badge credentials → DHCP/VLAN assignment fails. 3) Check carrier tracking for pallet → status 'Held for customs clearance - missing paperwork'.
logs: Carrier tracking: DHL AWB 382-12345678 - Held at Heathrow import hub since 2026-03-04. Customs message: 'Missing EORI/Invoice mismatch'. Building NAC logs (2026-03-08 09:12Z): RADIUS access-reject for badge ID b-4829 with error 'VLAN mapping not found'.
investigation_notes: - Customs: Procurement invoice omitted company EORI and item-level HS codes. Procurement team placed order via new vendor; vendor did not attach commercial invoice per EU import rules. - Badge VLAN: Network team confirmed the contractor badge pool is mapped to VLAN-guest in the central identity service, but Lon-2 site mapping uses a site-specific VLAN table (site key 'lon-2-ports') that omits the contractor pool. - No firmware or door-controller issues found. - Cross-checked with locker inventory: 3 spare docking stations available in LON-2 storeroom as temporary replacements.
hypothesis: Primary cause: administrative (shipping paperwork) causing customs hold. Secondary cause: onboarding template omission for Lon-2 site resulting in VLAN mapping gap for contractor badge pool.
actions_taken: - Facilities contacted DHL customs broker (reference CB-7743) to submit missing invoice and EORI; procurement provided corrected commercial invoice 2026-03-06. - Network team patched site VLAN table to include contractor pool mapping (temporary); pushed change to NAC and restarted RADIUS (2026-03-09 02:10Z). - Issued two temporary corporate Wi-Fi tokens to affected contractors and logged their devices for immediate access. - Pulled 3 spare docks from storeroom and staged them at desks pending pallet release.

resolution: Partial fix implemented: network VLAN mapping corrected and temporary equipment staged, allowing immediate access for contractors and partial desk readiness. Full resolution pending replacement monitors from vendor. Procurement to follow up with vendor credit and updated shipping checklist.
resolution_notes: - Monitors RMA initiated with vendor (RMA-2026-117). - Procurement updated PO template to include EORI and HS codes for EU shipments; new validation step added to procurement intake (PR-ops-229). - Facilities to maintain 3 emergency spare docks per new office for the next 90 days. - Network to add site mapping validation to onboarding playbook and include in pre-go-live checklist.
